body:
Pets have one need: happiness (Game rules, 31 Oct; no hunger).
- Unhappy signs: walks to the bowl, sniffs, sits by it; brings a toy and play-bows; yawns and lies down; follows you and nudges.
- Moods: very happy (big jumps, spin), sad (head and tail low, slow walk).
- Favourite food: the very-happy move plays as a short happy dance.
- Baby: clumsy walk, trips.
- One shared set for every pet, settings per type. Naps make pets happier.
Friends see this move too (Plan, 31 Oct: pets are sent online for real).

comments.text: Redone (your ask: bending legs, better physics): legs now bend at hip and knee with real gaits, head and tail move, people swing their arms, jumps follow an arc with crouch and landing squash, blob shadows. 6 critic rounds: best 6.5 of 10, never 8, so not passed yet.

Done: regrouped as Hungry and Unhappy (your two needs).
Same moves, new labels. OK if it fits.

Approved: you decided it in chat (Game rules, 31 Oct): one Unhappy set, no Hungry group.
Labels changed only; favourite food plays the very-happy move.

short: Pet signs: one Unhappy set, plus moods
source: chat 30 Oct: Model movements, first drafts
title: Pet moves: one shared set for all pets
